FN-W1NDD55-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 269
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Kerry (Bubba)
Government Underwood
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 269 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of certain local
government entities by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in: 1) the cost to
repair certain vehicles as provided by current procurement law; and 2) the cost of repairs as
permitted by this bill.
